cause.label: short_report
cause.what_happened: Iceberg Research published a short report on 2026-09-24 alleging understated LCOE and capex, an unrealistic timeline, a weak 18.5 GW pipeline and under 12 months of runway (about $350m unfunded, ~43% dilution). FISN fell about 10.9% that day and about 10.1% on 09-25. The company's 09-25 20:52 ET rebuttal disputed the report's credibility and addressed none of the numbers, and on 09-28 the stock fell another 9.1% by 15:04 ET on 1.58x volume. I found no new 09-28 item, so today reads as continuation of the report.
